text: We tested a weak-to-strong generalization method that reweights weak labels by the frozen strong model's margin, using a margin temperature of 0.5, with qwen2.5-0.5b as the weak supervisor and mistral-7b as the strong student. The weak model reaches 0.64 accuracy and the strong ceiling is 0.85; the transfer-trained student attains 0.83 accuracy with a standard error of 0.04. The resulting performance gap recovered is 0.89 with a standard error of 0.17, against a baseline PGR of 0.43. An important caveat is that these numbers come from num_seeds = 1, so the reported standard errors rest on a single run and no across-seed variability is captured. While the observed PGR sits above the baseline by more than twice its standard error, a single seed cannot establish how stable that ordering is, and replication across additional seeds would be needed before treating the margin-reweighting effect as established.
